messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Tokenization service reporting incorrect token counts leading to unexpected rate-limit (429) and quota rejections for some hosted customers starting ~02:00 UTC. Impact: ~2-4% of generation/embedding requests, skewed toward non-ASCII inputs. Live incident: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2812340000 :warning:

maya: I see spikes of token_count reported > actual. Example request: input length 1.2k chars but token_count 3.8k, which triggered quota block. Stack: tokenizer v1.7.0 landed in prod last night. sample log:
```
WARN tokenizer: token_count_mismatch detected input_id=abc123 reported=3789 expected=502
ERR quota: rejecting request tenant=tenant-acme reason=token_quota_exceeded
```

ryan: rolling back tokenizer to v1.6.4 on a small canary cohort to validate. command: `platformctl rollback --service tokenizer --version v1.6.4 --region us-east --percent 10`

jules: mitigation actions in flight:
- paused v1.7.0 rollout globally
- rolled back 10% canary -> 10% stable now
- temporarily relaxed token-based quota enforcement for affected tenants (soft-fail: allow up to +20% over reported limit while we validate)
- added extra validation on token_count path to sanity-check against character-based estimate before enforcing hard quotas

support: please queue a customer broadcast to tenants showing 429s: short note explaining we paused a tokenizer rollout and applied mitigations; advising retry/backoff. Flag enterprise accounts for 1:1 outreach.

maya: canary rollback shows token_count reports normalizing within two minutes on rolled-back hosts. p99 error 429 count dropped on those nodes. monitoring: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/tokenizer/token-counts?from=now-30m&to=now

oncall: collecting affected request ids and traces into artifacts: s3://incidents/2812340000/artifacts. grabbing tokenizer trace logs and sample inputs for reproduction. Please avoid rotating canary hosts until we capture them.

ryan: next steps: finish rollback to 100% if stable for 10m, add a short-term hotfix to v1.7.0 that reverts the new heuristic that mishandles non-ASCII combining characters, and add a preflight that compares token_count delta vs char_estimate > 3x for 100 sample requests before rollout.

jules: post-incident action items:
- ENG-13021: add char-estimate sanity check to quota enforcement path
- OPS-13022: add rollout guard when token_count variance > 200% for canary cohort
- QA-13023: add fuzz tests for tokenization on multi-lingual inputs

support: customer broadcast draft ready; will send after 10m steady-state. Support team standing by for replies.

maya: status: token_count errors down to baseline across rolled-back hosts. continuing to watch 20m before closing. If you see recurrence, tag `@oncall` and append logs to the incident artifacts. :white_check_mark:
